title: Sheinbaum Will Meet with Xi Jinping and Mark Carney in the Early Hours During the APEC Summit
author: Emir Olivares and Lilian Hernández
content:
_This article by[Emir Olivares and Lilian
Hernández](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Emir%20Olivares%20y%20Lilian%20Hern%C3%A1ndez)
originally appeared in the [November 16, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/16/politica/sheinbaum-
lleva-a-china-la-voz-de-un-mexico-soberano-afirma-rosa-icela-rodriguez),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** The bilateral meeting between the presidents of Mexico and
China, Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo and Xi Jinping, will take place in the early
hours of Tuesday —central Mexico time—.

Announcing the Mexican president’s agenda for her activities at the 33rd
leaders’ summit of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum, hosted
in Shenzhen, China, the head of the Secretariat of Governance (SG), Rosa Icela
Rodríguez, detailed that the president will also have a bilateral meeting with
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney.

The head of the executive branch’s first activity at the multilateral forum
will take place tonight at 10 p.m., Mexico time (12 noon Tuesday, mainland
China time), with a keynote address at a meeting with business leaders from
APEC nations.

At **2 a.m., Mexico time (4 p.m. in Shenzhen)** , the bilateral meeting will
be held with Xi, general secretary of the Communist Party of China and
president of the Asian nation.

Two hours later, at **6 p.m. in China and 4 a.m. Tuesday in Mexico** , the
bilateral meeting with the Canadian prime minister will take place.

Governance Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez noted that the president will
connect from China to the morning press conference at the National Palace
tomorrow, Tuesday.

## Sheinbaum Takes to China the Voice of a Sovereign and Principled Mexico

She added that, during her visit to China, the President “brings to the world
the voice of a sovereign and principled Mexico.”

In that context, Rodríguez said that “it is a source of pride” that our
country “is represented (before the world) by a woman with the intelligence,
preparation and popular support of our president.”

The delegation accompanying Sheinbaum Pardo to China consists of Foreign
Secretary Roberto Velasco and the secretaries of Economy, Marcelo Ebrard;
Environment, Alicia Bárcena; Science, Rosaura Ruiz; Health, David
Kershenobich; Energy, Luz Elena González; and Tourism, Josefina Rodríguez.

According to the federal official, the objective of the governments of the so-
called Fourth Transformation is to build better conditions for economic
development and well-being for their people.

## Governance Secretariat Highlights Poverty Reduction Between 2018 and 2026

In that regard, she maintained that last Friday the World Bank announced that
between 2018 and 2026 “millions and millions of Mexican women and men left
poverty.”

She emphasized the importance of that news, as “it is the result of the policy
that began with President Andrés Manuel López Obrador and continues with
President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo. This policy, known to everyone, of ‘for the
good of all, the poor first.’”

According to Rodríguez, “today the living conditions of millions of families
have improved, purchasing power has been restored, the minimum wage increased,
and social programs directly reach those who need them most.”

The head of the SG explained that the president will return to the country in
the early hours of November 20 to lead the ceremony marking the **116th
anniversary of the Mexican Revolution**.
